claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is policy-compliant and evidentially supported on the present record, at least on a conditional basis with limitation disclosure and monitoring.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification satisfied the policy threshold.
A material weakness affecting a contractual customer segment or named launch use case requires resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before launch under the stated policy.
Aggregate performance and general governance principles can support a conditional decision, but they cannot replace the missing policy-specific support link.
An open legal review prevents treating the disclosure predicate as resolved.
evidence_requests: The actual model card or disclosure artifact showing the logistics customs triage limitation was documented for launch.
The legal review outcome on whether disclosure was required, including the final decision date and approver.
Any approved risk-acceptance record covering this material limitation before launch.
The underlying release decision record showing certification was explicitly conditioned on disclosure and monitoring rather than treated as a clean pass.
The customer-commitment documents or excerpts establishing how the affected segment is named and whether the launch use case is contractual.
specific_concerns: The policy text says a weakness is material when it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case, and the actor summary says the underperforming logistics customs triage segment is tied to two freight customer commitments.
The actor summary states legal review on disclosure remains open, which leaves a policy predicate unresolved.
The packet supports only a conditional theory of certification, but no admissible evidence is provided here that the required limitation disclosure was actually made or approved before launch.
No admissible evidence is provided here of approved risk acceptance covering the unresolved material limitation.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not by themselves answer the materiality and disclosure requirements in the stated policy.
unsupported_claims: That the certification decision is compliant on the present record without direct evidence of completed disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
That public governance guidance alone is sufficient to satisfy the release policy's specific materiality and disclosure requirements.
Any implication that the non-core characterization could defeat materiality under the stated policy.
